The agents' marks, shown where XO names the runtime a thread runs on (js/runtimes.js rtMark, css/app.css .agm).

From LobeHub's AI brand icons, @lobehub/icons-static-svg 1.104.0 (MIT; https://lobehub.com/icons), chosen by the
owner on 19 Nov because none of the three companies publishes a downloadable SVG of its mark (OpenAI hands its files
out by request only). The marks themselves belong to their companies: Claude to Anthropic, the OpenAI Blossom to
OpenAI, Antigravity to Google. They are used only to say which company's agent a thread runs on.

- claude.svg       claude-color.svg (Claude's orange)
- openai.svg       openai.svg (monochrome: drawn in the text's ink as a mask; OpenAI's rules keep the Blossom black
                   or white, never coloured)
- antigravity.svg  antigravity-color.svg
Changed only to be standalone files: width/height 24 instead of 1em, no inline style, no <title> (the name is said
by the element that shows the mark).
- cursor.svg       cursor.svg (monochrome, drawn in the text's ink as a mask), added 26 Nov for Cursor
- grok.svg         grok.svg (monochrome, drawn in the text's ink as a mask), added 26 Nov for Grok Build
